title: FlowDefinition
description: Stored definition of a flow. Mirrors the engine FlowConfig (core/flow.ts). Stored as JSONB in flow_versions.definition. The cloud control-plane writes this; the app-server reads it to build the runtime route tree.

routes.description: Nested route tree. Each route maps a path segment to a page slug.

cachePolicy.description: Flow-level cache policy applied to all pages in this flow unless overridden.

cacheTtl.description: Cache TTL in seconds. Only meaningful when cachePolicy is 'ttl' or 'stale-while-revalidate'.

isStatic.description: When true, all non-dynamic pages are pre-rendered at startup and cached on the client.

version.description: Client-facing version number for cache invalidation. Bump to force clients to re-fetch.

path.description: Path segment(s). Supports dynamic params with ':' prefix (e.g. 'product/:id').

page.description: Slug of the page_definition to render at this route. Null for grouping-only routes.

children.description: Nested child routes. Matched after the parent path segments.

isDynamic.description: When true, this route always fetches fresh even in a static flow.

hooks.description: Route lifecycle hooks. In the cloud these are stored as action references, not raw JS.

onEnter.description: Action definition slug to execute on route enter.

onExit.description: Action definition slug to execute on route exit.

to.description: Route path to redirect to when condition matches.
